posts.content_md:
Hi everyone. I know absolutely nothing about holography but I am curious as to whether the following is possible at this time.

What i would like to do is take a video, such as a music video or a video of an music artist and project their picture in the form of a 3D holograph and have it be life size. Is this possible? Is the technology currently available to do this? If so, how would I buy it and how much money are we talking about? Thank you all in advance for your help.

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: It is not the technology that would be hard but the expense. If you had a NASA sized budget it would be possible.
